proposal2020.description: Authentication technology that helps manufacturers and consumers work together to identify and stop counterfeiting. Combining 3-layer AG algorithm, MD5 encryption, and ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards for unmatched supply chain protection.

aboutSection.intro: Since 2017, AuthenticGuards Technology has been committed to eradicating counterfeit products and building a secure trading ecosystem in Asia Pacific with 5-layer security technology.
aboutSection.missionDesc: To provide authentication technology that is affordable, accurate, and easy to adopt by brands across Asia Pacific to ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards.
aboutSection.visionDesc: To become the global standard in anti-counterfeit systems that protect products and consumers worldwide.

statsSection.subtitle: Eight years of dedication in protecting brands and consumers in Asia Pacific.

technologySection.subtitle: Five security layers working synergistically to create protection that is almost impossible for counterfeiters to breach.
technologySection.feat1Desc: Servers are protected by multi-layer protection that helps guard the application from common web exploits that can affect application availability or excessively consume resources.
technologySection.feat2Desc: 3-layer security code: personalization keywords, unique alphanumeric digits, and a unix timestamp matrix in milliseconds.
technologySection.feat3Desc: AG codes are hashed using the MD5 algorithm to produce a 32-character hex unique identifier that cannot be reversed.
technologySection.feat4Desc: Check limit of up to 15 times to reduce fraud and code duplication. Auto-suspend when the limit is reached.
technologySection.feat5Desc: When the code is attached to an opened/removed product, the QR code can no longer be used and is considered invalid.
technologySection.feat6Desc: Cloud database with ISO/IEC 27000:2016 and ISO/IEC 18004:2015 (QR Code Bar Code Symbology Specification) standards.

servicesSection.subtitle: Two main marking services fully integrated with the Authentic Guards system, designed for various industry needs.
servicesSection.ctaDesc: Need the right marking solution for your brand? Explore our services or consult your needs directly with our expert team.
servicesSection.svc1Desc: A combination of premium hologram with QR code for dual security layers that are hard to counterfeit. Integrated with AG's 5 security layers.
servicesSection.svc2Desc: High-quality tafeta label with an integrated QR code, designed specifically for the fashion and textile industry without compromising aesthetics.
servicesSection.svc3Desc: Instant verification via tap & go with NFC technology. Simply bring your smartphone close to the sticker to verify product authenticity.
servicesSection.svc4Desc: Direct QR printing on product packaging with client printer driver integration. High capacity for mass production.
